description:
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Valve Cover for the G13A & G13BA Engine.
Please look at pictures carefully as Suzuki has made minor changes to Cover.
Made by SUZUKI
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Valve Cover
Qty 1 – Oil Fill Cap
Qty 4 – Washers, Valve Cover
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
